attributes.name: bending
attributes.description: Bending at contact as a vector defining axis of rotation and angle (angle=norm).

attributes.name: contactPoint
attributes.description: some reference point for the interaction (usually in the middle). |ycomp|

attributes.name: initialOrientation1
attributes.description: Orientation of body 1 one at initialisation time |yupdate|

attributes.name: initialOrientation2
attributes.description: Orientation of body 2 one at initialisation time |yupdate|

attributes.name: normal
attributes.description: Unit vector oriented along the interaction, from particle #1, towards particle #2. |yupdate|

attributes.name: penetrationDepth
attributes.description: Penetration distance of spheres (positive if overlapping)

attributes.name: shearInc
attributes.description: Shear displacement increment in the last step

attributes.name: twistCreep
attributes.description: Stored creep, substracted from total relative rotation for computation of elastic moment |yupdate|

methods.name: incidentVel
methods.description: Return incident velocity of the interaction (see also Ig2_Sphere_Sphere_ScGeom.avoidGranularRatcheting for explanation of the ratcheting argument).

methods.name: relAngVel
methods.description: Return relative angular velocity of the interaction.
